subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset`: acknowledgement-only, startup/model greeting, configurable prompt text, explicit greeting model override, or a combined typed mode?
rationale: This choice changes token cost, session-start semantics, provider/model routing, and strict public config shape, so automation should not invent a new key or default while related reset policy items are still open.

options.title: Define A Unified Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Choose one typed config contract that covers ack-only behavior, startup/model turns, prompt customization, and optional model override before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Prompt And Fallthrough Trackers
options.body: Keep prompt text in the resetPrompt tracker and bare startup-turn restoration in the fallthrough tracker, leaving greeting-model selection out for now.

options.title: Keep Current Static Acknowledgements
options.body: Declare the current no-model default intentional and close or narrow this issue after documenting the supported `/new <message>` path.

recommendation.title: Define A Unified Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Choose one typed config contract that covers ack-only behavior, startup/model turns, prompt customization, and optional model override before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the current acknowledgement-only reset behavior, config compatibility policy, and linked maintainer-reviewed reset discussions.
